messages:
sara_cs: Orbitryx onboarding: p95 spikes during peak to ~450ms, tokens/sec down ~30% vs baseline. Account health: medium, renewal in ~3 months. Proactive idea: run compact quant canary + routing hedge to Dedicated. Any blockers?

tom_eng: Can you paste recent p50/p95 and which model they're using now?

sara_cs: last 24h: p95 452ms, p50 118ms, no error increase. They are on hosted redwood/gpt-alpha-v1.

tom_eng: Suggested non-invasive plan: 1) 5% canary to int8 quant variant, 2) prefer Dedicated in us-west-2 for canary, 3) enable KV prefix caching. Monitor quality diffs and latency for 24h.

mike_sre: Infra can reserve a small Dedicated pool for the 5% canary to reduce noise. Recommend request_timeout=10s during rollout.

elaine_enablement: I will run a 20-30min enablement with the Orbitryx PM to explain tradeoffs and show how to opt in/out. I can schedule Tue morning PST.

sara_cs: I'll collect qualitative feedback (hallucination, formatting). If OK, scale to 25% then 100% and use as renewal upsell signal.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary routing rule -> us-west-2 Dedicated pool (5%) at 2026-03-24T15:00:00Z

mike_sre: I'll monitor p95, throughput, and model equivocation. If latency improves and quality holds, ops will propose committed Dedicated as a renewal add-on.

sara_cs: Action items: (1) enablement Tue AM PST (elaine) (2) 5% canary Tue 15:00Z (deploy-bot/mike_sre) (3) feedback template + perf diff doc (sara_cs). I'll update CSM notes and tag renewal lead.

tom_eng: I can roll back to hosted variant within 5 minutes if needed.

sara_cs: thanks all. I will post Orbitryx feedback here after the session and first 24h of canary.
